description: Elections Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the office of member of the Namaloya Pradeshiya Sabha - Filling of a Vacancy in the office of member of the Damana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of elected members to fill seats vacated due to death or party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
